# Camp Resource: Mix-O-Matic

Lucky for you this broken down Mix-O-Matic still has some Cement in the back.

Generates Cement.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Mix-O-Matic__

**Produces**

Concrete Scrap

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

Cement Truck

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Materials required to craft resource**

TBA

**Holds**

2 Pounds

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - X - X Atoms

Atom Shop - X Bundle - X Atoms

**Produces X amount per**

Every 1 minute and 48 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

10 power

**Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit
